text:
maya: Deploybot just raised an AUTO-HOLD during the maintenance window — DB migration lock time trending high. Anyone seeing related errors?
deploy-bot: AUTO-HOLD triggered for service=redwood-api, reason=DBMigrationLockTime > 45s (canary traffic affected). Suggested action: pause rollout or rollback to last stable.
jordan: Thanks — is this the cert-rotation overlap we talked about?
ben: Confirming a small spike in dbenq queue and 502s from model-proxy around 02:18 UTC.
sam: p95 latency up ~1.8x on canary, error-rate spike to 3x baseline. I linked the dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/ABCD/canary-metrics
maya: Ok criteria check — if p95 > 1.5x or error-rate > 2x we should manual-rollback. That matches our rollback policy.
jordan: Agreed. Also add KV cache miss > 10% as an independent trigger.
ben: Copy. Who's taking the rollback action if we decide?
maya: I'll take it unless oncall prefers to. Preparing comms for customers now.
oncall-bot: Reminder: change window until 03:00 UTC. Escalation path: @oncall -> @sre -> @eng-lead.
sam: Quick sanity check — any schema changes in this migration?
maya: No schema changes, background index build. But it's contending with cert rotate jobs.
jordan: Given contention, recommend rollback to 2026-02-14 build (tag v2.14.1) for minimal diff.
deploy-bot: Rollback command available: `deploy rollback --service redwood-api --to v2.14.1 --reason "migration contention" --no-traffic-cut`
ben: If we rollback, let's also pin dedicated pools so we don't auto-redeploy.
maya: Good call. We'll pin and open a follow-up ticket for the index timing fix.
sam: I'll prepare the canary validation checklist post-rollback.
maya: Rolling back now. Running: `deploy rollback --service redwood-api --to v2.14.1`
deploy-bot: Rollback started (id=rb-61415927). Progress: 0/3 regions.
ben: Pinging support to draft customer note: "We briefly paused an upgrade during scheduled maintenance due to DB contention; service is back to the prior stable build while we investigate."
jordan: I'll update release notes and mark this as manual rollback in the changelog.
oncall-bot: Rollback completed in 1 region. Monitoring for residual errors.
sam: Post-rollback metrics look normal in eu-west.
maya: All regions showing green. Closing the hold and unpinning only after we confirm index scheduling fix.
jordan: Filing postmortem checklist — owner: maya, ETA: EOD.
maya: Thanks team. I'll post a short blameless note in #eng-postmortems once root cause confirmed. :thumbsup:
